attempt: Persist ZytaleGenerated:AdaptiveSurfaceWorld as Enabled=true and rely on the plugin constructor to regenerate its missing ZIP.
reason_failed: The Hytale client checks enabled mod manifests before launching the Java server. In the reported world the enabled generated identifier remained but ZAS_ActivePack.zip was absent, so the constructor could never run. Dedicated-server bootstrap tests did not exercise this prerequisite barrier.
environment: Windows; reported with installed Surface 0.12.4 and Hytale client/server 0.7.4; prior proposed 0.12.5 shared the same enabled-pack design
conditions: World config lists its identifier as enabled
Client checks prerequisites before executing the mod
workaround: Keep the derived cache out of mod discovery, load it during initial plugin setup, never persist it enabled, and migrate already-blocked saves once with backups.

source_refs.description: Observed missing-mod failure, local repair and startup validation on installed Hytale 0.7.4
Final artifact hashes, nine native passes, preliminary failure retained, preservation audit
